entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 23.08.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Narayanpur P.S. Case No.96 of 2022 (POCSO Case No.17 of 2022),
registered for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of committing rape upon a minor girl.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.

Further, it has been submitted by referring to the statement made under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. and the FIR of the victim girl that there is much contradiction in the Bikash Mandal @ Vikash Mandal vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43333821/
1 said statement.

entities.text: Bikash Mandal @ Vikash Mandal vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further, this case is nothing but pressure tactic for the purpose of marriage.
As per the medical report, her age has been found just below eighteen years.
The applicant is a student and he was having good friendship with the victim-girl in question.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that the girl has supported the allegation.
7. Having heard the parties and from perusal of the records, it appears that the girl in question is minor and she has made allegation against this applicant.
8. Considering the above facts, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands rejected.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
